data: • Premium sport‑touring design with multi‑composite fiber shell & EPS anti‑vibration liner.
• Aerodynamic shape (aggressive lines, rear spoiler) reduces drag.
• Comfort: removable & washable interior, emergency cheek‑pad removal, enveloping neck‑roll for wind‑noise reduction.
• Advanced visor system – quick‑release X‑Black N’Seal, anti‑fog Pinlock 120 XLT lens, internal sun visor, optional photochromic visor.
• Ventilation: two intakes, two exhausts, internal cooling chamber.
• Customisation: compatible with X‑Com3/Pro intercom, action‑camera mounts, multiple colours/graphics.
• High price (base €459.99; > €600 for top models) may limit accessibility.
• Optional accessories (intercom, photochromic visor, camera mounts) add cost & installation steps.
• Limited size range – only three shell sizes (XXS–3XL) with no custom fitting.
• Expanding accessory ecosystem (intercoms, camera mounts, photochromic visors).
• Appeal to eco‑conscious buyers via carbon‑fiber options.
• Potential expansion beyond Portugal into broader EU and global markets.
• Strong competition from other premium helmet brands.
• Economic fluctuations may curb discretionary spending on high‑priced helmets.
• Possible future regulatory or safety‑standard changes requiring redesign.
